description.value: A payments and point-of-sale company, now part of Block, whose business has expanded well beyond card readers.
A payments and point-of-sale company for small and mid-sized businesses, presented as a single platform for taking payments and running the business.

product_description.value: Card and contactless payment processing with POS software for restaurants, retail and appointment-based businesses, plus hardware such as terminals and card readers. Also online ordering and stores, invoicing, marketing and loyalty tools, staff scheduling, business loans and Square Card.
A point-of-sale platform, launched in 2009, that lets businesses accept card payments and manage payroll, bookings, inventory, e-commerce, banking and business loans.
Point-of-sale systems, Square Capital business loans, payroll, customer engagement tools, e-commerce, inventory management, invoicing and a mobile card reader.

business_model_description.value: Earns from payment processing fees and subscriptions. The 2015 SEC filing describes a low-cost, self-serve model in which Square acts as a payment service provider that sets its own pricing, chargeback and risk policies.

customer_description.value: Mainly small businesses and sole proprietors, including individual entrepreneurs and freelancers.
Small and mid-sized businesses in food and beverage, retail, beauty (salons, barbershops, spas) and services such as trades, automotive, professional services, pet care, cleaning and landscaping.
A 2022 survey found 35% of U.S. small business owners used Square.

revenue.value: $22.1 billion (2024; total Block gross revenue, per Salesmotion)

founded_year.value: February 14, 2009 (as Square, Inc.; renamed Block, Inc. in December 2021)

headquarters.value: No formal headquarters; principal office in Oakland, California (Block, Inc.)
